name: Top-3 momentum
rules: At each month-end, rank 10 ETFs by 12-month return. Hold the top 3, one-third of the account each, but only those that beat T-bills; any slot that doesn’t goes to BIL (T-bills). Rebalance monthly at the close.
universe: SPY, QQQ, IWM, EFA, EEM, VNQ, TLT, IEF, GLD, DBC (+ BIL as cash)
spy_dd_note: Measured on month-end closes, which hides the Feb–Mar 2020 low.

name: SPY above 10-month average
rules: At month-end, hold 100% SPY if it closed above its 10-month average; otherwise hold 100% BIL (T-bills).
spy_dd_note: Measured on month-end closes, which hides the Feb–Mar 2020 low.

name: Dip buying, RSI(2) < 10
rules: If SPY or QQQ is above its 200-day average and its 2-day RSI drops below 10, buy at the next day’s open. Sell at the first close above the 5-day average, or after 10 days at most. No stop. 100% of the account, one position at a time.
dd_note: Measured trade-to-trade, so the real drop inside trades was somewhat larger.
spy_dd_note: Not computed in the run: SPY’s Feb–Mar 2020 COVID crash, from market history.
